title: 第二章 陷入危机
content_zh:
而他身边的人也不是等闲之辈，当年最壮大的时候十五万定永军，五千精锐，三百心腹一路下来过关斩将所向披靡，直逼长安。

    可惜因为内奸叛徒所害，定永大军分崩离析，死的死亡的亡，留在李磊身边的乃是真正精英中的精英，真正的出生入死的兄弟。

    他们的修为也是非常强横，除了李磊的副官刘听寒之外是心动后期之外，几乎都是心动中期左右，就连最弱的都是融合后期。他们都是这么强横了，追击他们的那群黑衣人也是相当厉害。为首的虽然没有李磊强，但也是和刘听寒一样是一名心动后期强者。

    其他黑衣人虽然个人修为没有李磊一群人那般强横，但是他们人多啊!虽然每个境界的差距都很大，但在没有到达元婴期之前，所有的差距都可以用人数、兵器、道具等来弥补。

    “李磊，我孙志才念在咱们兄弟多年，最后给你一次机会，赶紧投降!”一会那个领头的黑衣人又说道，但这一次明显比之前要显得不耐烦许多。

    而李磊并没有因为孙志才的话动摇，甚至连眉头都没有动一下，好像根本没有听到那孙志才说的话一样，一心骑马向前飞驰。

    “好!很好！你可真是敬酒不吃吃罚酒了，来人给我放箭!”孙志才一脸狰狞的大叫道。

    孙志才所率领的那群黑衣人收到命令也是赶快做出行动。

    有数千个黑衣人拿起弓箭拉弓瞄准李磊一行人，“唰唰唰”无数箭矢如同暴雨一样向李磊他们飞掠过去。

    而李磊他们也不坐以待毙，一边骑着马躲着一边拿出他们手中的武器把向他们射来的箭矢挡了下来。

    可是面对这满天箭雨哪怕是李磊他们这修为也是挡不多久，不一会李磊周围的人就陆陆续续的被那射来的箭洞穿了身体从马背上摔了下来。

    虽然身体被那箭洞穿但以他们的修为来看并不太严重。只是他们身后袭来的孙志才等黑衣人可不管受没受伤，只要被追上那后果可想而知，一个个受伤的人仿佛像一个个尘埃一样被那大军吞没，最后只是剩下一具具冰冷是尸体，死状更是非常可怕!

    看到这一幕就连一向波澜不惊的李磊也都微微皱起了眉头。虽然他皱起了眉头，但这可不是因为李磊害怕了，李磊可不是贪生怕死之辈，而是看他身边那些兄弟们原本有几百人之多，可现在竟然只有几十个人了。一个个鲜活的生命竟然都这样凋谢了，李磊甚是心疼。

    可突然李磊瞳孔一缩，一支支箭矢像流光一样向他的副官刘听寒射了过去。而刘听寒眼看箭向他飞掠更是躲闪不及。

    “呼”只见李磊顺势从马上跳起身来向刘听寒身前扑了过去，李磊这是要为刘听寒挡下这几箭!

    还没等刘听寒反应过来只听见“噗噗噗”箭矢射入李磊身体的声音，瞬间李磊就像断了线的风筝一样狠狠的摔在了地上，甚至因为惯性李磊还翻滚了几圈才停了下来。
content_en:
And the people around him were no ordinary people either. At their peak, there were 150,000 Dingyong troops, 5,000 elites, and 300 confidants who came all the way to cross the border and be invincible, approaching Chang'an.

    It is a pity that Dingyong's army fell apart due to the traitors and traitors, and those who stayed with Li Lei were the true elites among the elites, true brothers who had experienced life and death.

    Their cultivation levels are also very strong. Except for Li Lei's adjutant Liu Tinghan, who is in the late stage of heartbeat, almost all of them are around the middle stage of heartbeat, and even the weakest ones are in the late stage of fusion. They are so tyrannical, and the group of men in black chasing them are also quite powerful. Although the leader is not as strong as Li Lei, he is as strong as Liu Tinghan in the late stage of heartbeat.

    Although the other men in black are not as tyrannical in personal cultivation as Li Lei's group, there are so many of them! Although the gap in each realm is huge, before reaching the Nascent Soul stage, all the gaps can be made up with the number of people, weapons, props, etc.

    "Li Lei, I, Sun Zhicai, have been with us for many years. I will give you one last chance. Surrender immediately!" After a while, the leading man in black said again, but this time he was obviously much more impatient than before.

    But Li Lei was not shaken by Sun Zhicai's words, and he didn't even move his brows. It was as if he didn't hear what Sun Zhicai said at all, and he rode forward with all his heart.

    "Okay! Very good! You really don't want to drink wine as a penalty. Someone shoot an arrow for me!" Sun Zhicai shouted with a ferocious look on his face.

    The group of men in black led by Sun Zhicai also acted quickly after receiving the order.

    Thousands of men in black picked up their bows and arrows and aimed at Li Lei and his group. Countless arrows flew towards Li Lei and his group like a heavy rain.

    Li Lei and the others did not sit still and waited for death. They took out the weapons in their hands and blocked the arrows fired at them while hiding on horseback.

    However, facing the rain of arrows from the sky, even Li Lei and his friends couldn't stop them for long. After a while, people around Li Lei were pierced by the arrows and fell off their horses one after another.

    Although their bodies were pierced by the arrow, judging from their cultivation, it was not too serious. It's just that Sun Zhicai and the other men in black who attacked behind them didn't care whether they were injured or not. As long as they were caught up, the consequences could be imagined. Each of the injured people seemed to be swallowed up by the army like dust. In the end, only cold corpses were left, and the state of death was even more terrifying!

    Seeing this scene, even Li Lei, who had always been calm, frowned slightly. Although he frowned, it was not because Li Lei was afraid. Li Lei was not a person who was afraid of death. It was because the brothers around him originally numbered in the hundreds, but now there were only a few dozen. Li Lei felt very sad that all the living lives had withered away like this.

    But suddenly Li Lei's pupils shrank, and arrows shot towards his adjutant Liu Tinghan like streams of light. Liu Tinghan saw the arrow flying towards him and was unable to dodge.

    "Huh!" Li Lei jumped up from his horse and rushed towards Liu Tinghan. Li Lei was trying to block these arrows for Liu Tinghan!

    Before Liu Tinghan could react, he only heard the sound of the arrow shooting into Li Lei's body. In an instant, Li Lei fell to the ground like a kite with a broken string. He even rolled a few times due to inertia before he stopped.
